about_short_description.short_description: Shimmer provides a platform for 1:1 remote ADHD coaching

product.name: Shimmer ADHD Coaching
product.description: A personalized 1:1 remote coaching service designed to help adults with ADHD manage symptoms and improve daily functioning through weekly sessions and tailored strategies.

product.name: Coach Network and Training
product.description: A professional network and training platform for ADHD coaches, providing supervision, resources, and community support to enhance coaching practices.

product.name: Science-Backed Learning Modules
product.description: Educational modules based on ADHD research designed to support clients' understanding and management of ADHD-related challenges.

product.name: Accountability and Productivity Tools
product.description: Digital tools designed to help clients set goals, track progress, and maintain accountability between coaching sessions.

product.name: Daily Body Doubling Sessions
product.description: Coach-hosted live sessions where clients work alongside others to increase focus and task completion through shared presence.
